Be responsible for designing resilient, scalable, and secure network environments that empower our customers to achieve their digital transformation goals. Beyond design and deployment, your impact will be measured by your ability to bridge the gap between complex engineering and executive stakeholders. You will act as a mentor and technical lead, ensuring that our internal teams and the customer’s engineering staff are fully enabled to support and evolve these environments. Deep technical proficiency in enterprise switching, including L2/L3 protocols, VXLAN, and EVPN. Consistent record of designing and running Campus Fabric deployments for enterprise environments. Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical staff and business leadership. Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams and mentor junior engineers. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-touch, enterprise-level (Premier) accounts. Deep familiarity with software-defined networking (SDN) and automated provisioning workflows. Active professional-level industry certifications (e.g., CCIE, CCNP, or equivalent). Experience with multi-vendor integration and complex legacy-to-modern network migrations. Strong enablement background, including creating technical documentation, delivering workshops, and facilitating knowledge transfer sessions. At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Link is quality and compliance-focused, under our guiding philosophy, “Mission First, Customer Always". We are certified in ISO 9001:2015, ISO 20000-1:2018, and ISO 27001:2022; CMMC Level 2 certified; and appraised at CMMI Maturity Level 3 for Services and Development. Job Description Link Solutions is seeking a PC Support Technician to join our Fort Leavenworth, KS. US Citizen with an active DoW Secret Clearance IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher Non-remote (relocation incentive available) The PC Support Technician will support the US Army Corrections Command (ACC) Army Corrections Brigade (ACB) G6 by providing desktop and technical support services to military, civilian, and contractor personnel. This role is responsible for installing, configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining computer hardware, software, mobile devices, printers, and peripheral equipment to ensure reliable IT operations. Responsibilities include resolving hardware and software issues, supporting user accounts and system access, imaging and deploying workstations, managing service tickets, maintaining IT asset inventories, and assisting with technology refreshes and upgrades. The Technician will collaborate with other IT teams to resolve complex issues and help ensure compliance with Army and Department of Defense (DoD) cybersecurity policies and procedures. Join our dynamic team at a top-tier organization, where work-life balance and employee well-being take center stage. This exciting opportunity allows you to support mission-critical operations and contribute directly to our nation's security. Job Responsibilities: Provide help desk and desktop support services, diagnose technical issues, and implement resolutions or temporary workarounds when immediate resolution is not possible. Install, configure, troubleshoot, maintain, and relocate desktop computers, laptops, printers, peripheral devices, and related hardware and software. Perform system imaging, software installations, upgrades, patches, and operating system configuration to optimize system performance. Install and configure network adapters, internet connections, and peripheral devices. Diagnose and resolve network connectivity, cabling, and configuration issues. Respond to user inquiries and service requests, providing technical assistance for PCs, servers, hardware, software, operating systems, and standard business applications. Coordinate technical support activities with the local Network Enterprise Center (NEC) and other IT support organizations. Manage and resolve service tickets for Training Management Directorate (TMD) users in accordance with established service level requirements. Maintain IT asset inventories and documentation related to hardware, software, and system configurations. Support the implementation and maintenance of organizational IT standards, policies, and procedures. Provide on-call support outside normal business hours for scheduled maintenance, service interruptions, and mission-critical incidents. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Qualifications U.S. Citizen with an active DoW Secret Clearance. IAT Level II certification or higher in accordance with DoD 8570.01-M / DoD 8140 requirements (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP, or equivalent). Two (2+) years of experience as a PC Support Technician, Help Desk Specialist, Desktop Support Technician, or in a related IT support role. Experience installing, configuring, troubleshooting, and supporting PC, workstation, and server hardware and software. Experience diagnosing and resolving network connectivity, cabling, and network interface issues. Experience providing help desk and desktop support, identifying technical issues, and implementing effective solutions. Experience responding to user inquiries and providing technical assistance for PC systems, operating systems, and standard business applications. Knowledge of Windows workstation administration and support. Current certification in one or more of the following technologies: Microsoft Windows 10/11, Microsoft Server 2016/2019, or Microsoft Modern Desktop Administrator. Preferred: Associate's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience working in a Department of Defense (DoD) environment. Experience providing quality service and support for mission-critical systems and VIP end users. Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and interpersonal skills. Superior organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks. Problem solver and troubleshooter who thrives in resolving complex problems. Strong self-starter requiring minimal supervision. Link Solutions, Inc. is an EOE. AA/M/F/D/V. We participate in the E-Verify Employment Verification Program. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
